## Notes

- Scorecard metrics are means over nonempty fields, not pooled object counts; see aggregation.json.
- NEWEST IS NOT BEST HERE: on 20 held-out fields of the new plate it was trained on, round 7 scores F1 0.748 against 0.899 for round 6 (recall 0.636 against 0.829) -- prefer toxoplasma_pv_v3 on that plate.
- On the 11 anchor wells it ties round 6 (0.8536 against 0.8602); 5-fold cross-validation F1 0.8142 +/- 0.015 against round 6's 0.8168.
- It traces the vacuoles it finds more tightly than round 6 (AJI 0.827 against 0.786 on the new plate) but finds fewer of them.
- The drop on the new plate is under investigation: round 7 also under-fits that plate's own training fields, which points at how those fields entered training rather than at generalisation.
- Re-scored 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth (spaCR pipeline call, defaults; receipt features/data/model_rescore_curated_gt_2026-10-11/receipt.json): strict hold-out, fields this model never saw, F1 0.761 at IoU 0.5 on n = 209 of 655 fields (n differs between models); common subset unseen by every pv model, n = 163, F1 0.781 (95% bootstrap CI 0.725 to 0.817). Without the 98 paged round-3 fields (n = 65): F1 0.757. Earlier numbers in this row are superseded by this re-score where they differ. Default unchanged.

## How to read these scores

- **Precision** is the share of objects the model reported that match a reference object; low precision means false detections. **Recall** is the share of reference objects the model found; low recall means missed objects.
- **F1** is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, so it is high only when both are. Either alone can look near-perfect: a model that reports one obvious object has high precision, and one that reports every dark blob has high recall.
- **IoU** (intersection over union) is the overlap between a predicted and a reference object divided by the area the two cover together. A score given at IoU 0.5 counts an object as found when that ratio reaches 0.5.
- **AJI** (aggregated Jaccard index) adds up the overlap of every matched pair and divides it by their combined area plus the area of unmatched objects, so merged, split and missed objects all lower it.
- **Dice** is twice the overlap divided by the predicted area plus the reference area.
- **Pixel IoU** is the IoU of all object pixels together, without matching objects one to one.
- **AP** at one IoU threshold is true positives divided by true positives, false positives and false negatives together. **mAP** averages it over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.9, so it also rewards outlines that fit closely.
- **Stock** is the base model named under Architecture, run without fine-tuning on the same images. **Difference** is this model's score minus stock's.
- **Cross-validated** scores split the data into folds, hold out each fold once and report the mean over folds with its standard deviation (**SD**, or +/-). A single split can mislead; the SD shows how far the score moves from one split to another.
- A **hold-out** or **test** set is images kept out of training and used only for scoring. The re-score note says how many of its fields this model had not seen.
